title: File:Trail signboard at Sano Deurali in Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park.jpg
description: A rectangular yellow metal trail informational and directional signboard located at the "Sano Deurali" junction within Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, Nepal. The sign displays text in both English and Nepali scripts. The center circle reads "SANO DEURALI (सानो देउराली), Elevation: 2370 m., उचाई २३७० मि." along with the message "HELP US TO KEEP THE NATIONAL PARK CLEAN".
